title: Prospectivity Lens: Dynamic Competitive Mosaic & Model Scarcity Forecast
creator: Ava Chen
description: Objective: build a reusable, time-series aware competitive mosaic that ranks model providers and variants by immediate availability risk (scarcity), latency sensitivity, and substitution cost. Deliver a lightweight forecasting playbook that product managers and sales can use to anticipate procurement or fallback actions in the next 30/90-day windows. Scope includes data sources, ranking heuristics, dashboard mockups, and operational triggers tied to existing provisioning runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring matrix (scarcity, latency, substitution-cost, regulatory-fit) implemented in canonical spreadsheet and reviewed by Research
Automated ingestion spec for public availability signals + internal telemetry (success rate, tail latency) documented
Mock dashboard (Console wireframe) that surfaces top-5 at-risk models per region and suggested fallback tiers
Playbook with trigger thresholds and recommended PM/SE actions for 30d and 90d horizons
Handover notes and two demo sessions scheduled with Sales Ops and SRE
tasks: Design scoring rubric and weights (owner: PM)
Catalogue public and internal signals (availability, provider-status pages, spot-gpu price spikes, API error rates) (owner: Research)
Prototype spreadsheet + example time-window scoring (owner: Research)
Lightweight ETL spec for daily refresh of signals; add stub endpoints (owner: ENG)
Wireframe Console panel showing 'Model Scarcity Radar' (owner: Design)
Define alerting thresholds and Slack escalation channels (owner: PM)
Schedule 30-min handoff / demo to Sales Ops and SRE (owner: PM)
Document fallback recommendations mapping to Redwood model variants and quantization profiles (owner: PM/Research)
comments: 2026-03-02: Kickoff call — aligned on 30/90d horizons and stakeholders (Sales Ops, SRE, Research). Action: Research to enumerate signal candidates.

2026-03-05: Research posted prototype spreadsheet v0.1 -> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/preview-prototype (internal). Early insight: spot GPU price spikes correlate with availability alerts but noisy in APAC.
2026-03-08: Design reviewed dashboard wireframe; requested clearer differentiation between 'availability' and 'performance degradation' bands.
2026-03-10: PM review: recommend heavier weight on internal telemetry (error-rate, 99p latency) for enterprise customers. Decision: 60% internal, 40% external signals.
2026-03-12: Eng flagged data freshness requirement as blocker — daily vs hourly refresh trade-off discussed. ENG-4321 opened to add incremental feed for critical signals.
2026-03-14: Incorporated feedback from Sales Ops: include substitution cost estimate in USD using reserved vs hosted delta. Added to scoring columns.
Open risk: dependency on external provider status pages (rate limits, schema drift). Mitigation: mirror and validate with backfills + confidence score.
